calls.reason: A May 2025 Yahoo Finance liveblog briefly mentions smuggling, which undercuts the literal blanket wording. But the core claim is rhetorical, and no evidence measures how much illegal sales added to NVIDIA's growth.

AP (citing the Times) and Culper report about $4.8B in Megaspeed purchases of NVIDIA chips. No source turns this into NVIDIA revenue or confirms Mainland China destinations, and Megaspeed denies wrongdoing.
DOJ releases show real smuggling of NVIDIA chips in 2024-25, but the link to NVIDIA's own sales over several years rests on Culper's short-seller allegations, and NVIDIA denies finding diversion.
